spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अणति)
To sound.
(ङ,) 4th cl. (अण्यते)
To breathe, to live;
with प्र,
to exist, to live. See अन.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Inferior, low.
E.
अण to sound, अच् affix; and कन् affix of depreciation; also written अणक, and आणक.

n. (-व्यं)
A field bearing panic.
E.
अणु panic, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Bearing or fit to bear panic.
E.
अणु panic, and खञ् aff.
